title: VTA Notifications — Show — payload
description: A client with standing in a trust context reads one notification its VTA holds there, with the document that delivered it exactly as received — the notifications/notify document, or the notifications/relay document carrying it — so the client can verify the originator's proof and every relay itself rather than take the VTA's word (VTI-NTF-050). A read changes nothing, and sends nothing to anyone. The outer document members (id, type, issuer, recipient, issuedAt, expiresAt, proof) are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

document.description: The document that delivered the revision held, kept whole and exactly as received — proof included: the notifications/notify/0.1 document, or the outermost notifications/relay/0.1 document. An opaque object, so that every member its issuer signed survives unchanged for the client to verify.
